Scenario_Name: Crude Charge Pump Bearing Seizure Under High Production Target & Delayed Maintenance
Leading_Indicators: PM work order overdue by 18 days
Risk_Amplifiers: Night shift crew with 14 consecutive overtime hours
Safety_Barriers: Standby pump P-102B automatic start interlock
Potential_Outcomes: Pump bearing destruction, catastrophic seal rupture, volatile crude hydrocarbon cloud ignition, CDU emergency blackout
Recommended_Investigation: Verify P-102B coupling integrity, perform oil spectrography, review operator overtime rosters
Recommended_Actions: Gracefully de-rate CDU throughput to 85%, swap feed service to P-102B, tag out P-102A for rebuild

Scenario_Name: Wet Gas Compressor Seal Failure Under High Ambient Heat & Low Utility Water Flow
Leading_Indicators: Primary seal vent flow FT-601 spiking
Cooling water supply temperature at 34 C
Abnormal_Conditions: Dry gas seal face thermal deformation
Interstage knock-out drum liquid level rising
Risk_Amplifiers: High export gas market price creating management reluctance to derate
Single certified compressor technician on site
Potential_Outcomes: Toxic and flammable wet gas release to atmosphere, emergency flare trip, potential compressor casing damage
Recommended_Investigation: Measure seal gas filter differential pressure, inspect secondary vent flame arrestor
Recommended_Actions: Increase nitrogen buffer supply pressure, activate auxiliary cooling water booster pump, derate compressor by 15%
